articles.title: September Market Recap & Micron’s AI Boom
articles.summary: The Close brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are BlackRock Head of Model Portfolio Solutions, Americas Michael Gates, Robinhood Markets Chairman & CEO Vlad Tenev, University of Michigan Professor of Economics and Public Policy Betsey Stevenson, Morgan Stanley Investment Management Head of Global Real Assets Lauren Hochfelder, Janus Henderson Head of Americas Equities Marc Pinto, Gabelli Research Analyst & Portfolio Manager Hendi Susanto, Redpoint Ventures Managing Director Erica Brescia, VSORA Chair Sandra Rivera, JPMorgan Asset Management Global Alternatives Strategist Aaron Mulvihill, Seaport Research Partners Senior Analyst David Joyce, & Next Legacy Managing Partner Ryan Nece. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Ackman on AI & IPOs, Climate Costs, Paramount's Debt Raise
articles.summary: A weekly, midday program that delivers high-impact, editorially driven coverage of the most important corporate transactions shaping the global market. Today's guests: Pershing Square CEO & Founder Bill Ackman, Pulse Fund Founder & Managing Partner Tenzin Seldon, EQT Partner, Head of AI Infrastructure Jan Vesely, BCG Global Head of Sustainable Investing Vinay Shandal, and JPMorgan Private Bank Global Head of Alternative Investments Kristin Kallergis Rowland. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Robinhood CEO Says New AI-Driven Agent Apps Are Safe
articles.summary: Robinhood Markets Chairman and CEO Vlad Tenev discusses the firm’s new AI-driven agent apps unveiled during a Houston summit. Speaking on "Bloomberg The Close," Tenev outlines a vision of giving individual traders hedge fund-like tools, including 24/7 trading across asset classes, autonomous “agent loops” that can operate while users sleep, and access to specialized data sources such as satellite imagery and blockchain analytics. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Embedding AI Risks Into Investments: Rowland
articles.summary: Kristin Kallergis Rowland, global head of alternative investments at JPMorgan Private Bank, joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." Kristin Kallergis Rowland explains how an investor ends up being on both the bull and bear side of AI. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: OpenAI’s $30B Bet, Trump’s AI Safety Shift and Apple’s Next Act
articles.summary: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow breaks down OpenAI's plan to raise at least $30 billion from investors in a new round of funding after pushing back its plans for an IPO. Plus, President Trump supports using outside auditors to assess the safety of AI systems after meeting with Silicon Valley leaders; and Apple keeps pushing the envelope under new CEO John Ternus with plans to make its foray into the smart-home market. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: AI Infrastructure Firm Accelevation Edges Down 2.5% After IPO
articles.summary: Shares of Accelevation Holdings Corp., a data center infrastructure company, declined 2.5% after the company and its private equity backer raised $540 million in an initial public offering priced below its marketed range.
articles.author: Matthew Griffin

articles.title: JPMorgan’s Sundar Sees ‘Healthy’ Tumult of Two AI Cycles at Once
articles.summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co.’s Sitara Sundar urged investors to diversify their bets on artificial intelligence because the industry is caught in the “healthy” volatility of two cycles occurring at once.
articles.author: Dani Burger

articles.title: AI Cycles Are Running in Tandem, Says JPMorgan's Sundar
articles.summary: Sitara Sundar, head of alternative investment strategy at JPMorgan Private Bank, says diversifying across the AI value chain is the best strategy for investors. Sundar also says volatility we see now in the tech space is healthy. She speaks to Bloomberg's Dani Burger on "Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: AMD buys AI world model startup World Labs for $8.2 billion
articles.summary: Fei-Fei Li's AI startup World Labs is being acquired by AMD for $8.2 billion. Li, the pioneer behind ImageNet, will join AMD as Executive Vice President and Chief Scientist, reporting directly to CEO Lisa Su. World Labs brings its spatial intelligence models, including Atlas, which generates and simulates 3D environments from minimal input. AMD gains its own AI research unit focused on physical-world models, sharpening its competition with Nvidia. articles.author: Matthias Bastian

articles.title: Altman on OpenAI's IPO Plans, AI Agent Dots, AI Security
articles.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman talks about launching its new AI personal agent called Dots, which he says is a premium product. Altman also says the company will go public at some point, but it's being patient. He speaks to Bloomberg's Ed Ludlow in San Francisco. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Sam Altman Says OpenAI Investors Patient With IPO Plan
articles.summary: CEO Sam Altman says OpenAI ultimately wants to become a public company, but not yet. Speaking with Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg The Close," Altman pushes back on the idea that the responsibilities of being public are incompatible with a focus on safety. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: AMD Goes Big on World Models as Anthropic Heads to IPO
articles.summary: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow breaks down President Trump's new AI-powered website America.gov, putting AI at the center of his agenda. Plus, Anthropic warns of "existential risks to humanity" in its prospectus ahead of its IPO according to reports, and AMD makes a big AI bet on the frontier by acquiring Fei-Fei Li's World Labs in an all-stock deal valued at $8.2 billion. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Metaview wants to eliminate recruiting grunt work and speed up hiring after raising $60M in funding
articles.summary: Artificial intelligence recruiting software startup Metaview Labs Inc. said today the industry is ready for a “Claude Code moment” after it closed on $60 million in a Series C funding. The round was led by Insight Partners and saw the participation of GV, Seedcamp, Vertex Ventures US, Intrepid Growth Partners, Plural and Garuda Ventures. articles.title: Anthropic's IPO filing shows soaring revenue, mounting costs, and "existential" risks
articles.summary: Anthropic warns in its own IPO prospectus that its AI technology could pose "existential risks to humanity." Revenue grew twelvefold in 2025 to $4.6 billion, but the operating loss widened to $8.06 billion. Backers are aiming for a valuation above $2 trillion, and the IPO is expected to set the bar for the entire AI industry. articles.title: Santos: AI Euphoria Meets Reality
articles.summary: Gabriela Santos, Chief Market Strategist for the Americas at JPMorgan Asset Management says the recent surge in Treasury yields looks overdone, arguing the US economy is resilient but normalizing rather than booming. She urges investors to favor high‑quality large caps over speculative AI plays, watch leverage and stay selective in banks as secular AI forces drive market dispersion. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Anthropic’s IPO pitch includes a warning about human extinction
articles.summary: The Claude maker warns its own models could resist shutdowns and cause catastrophic harm.
articles.author: George Hammond, Financial Times

articles.title: ExodusPoint Joins Hedge Funds Partnering With Anthropic Over AI
articles.summary: ExodusPoint Capital Management is working with Anthropic PBC to expand the use of artificial intelligence agent Claude across its hedge fund operations.

articles.title: Anthropic IPO to Be a ‘Watershed Event’ for Tech, Says Ives
articles.summary: Dan Ives, partner and senior managing director at Yorkville Ives & Co., examines Anthropic PBC as the company prepares to file its initial public offering and looks at the growing list of concerns surrounding AI. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Telecom Giant Globe Bets on AI for Next Billion-Dollar Business
articles.summary: Globe Telecom Inc. is betting the artificial intelligence boom can turn its data-center venture into its next billion-dollar business as fintech arm Mynt Inc. heads for a record Philippine initial public offering.
